source: CalcGallery, Kerf Bending Calculator, 12 in inside-radius quick reference and calculation method
conversion: 1 in = 25.4 mm; source radius is to the inside face, so outside radius is inside radius plus 3/4 in stock thickness. Spacing = outside radius × kerf width ÷ cut depth; cut depth = stock thickness − uncut web. Outside arc length = outside radius × π/2.
tolerance: 0.32 mm for spacing, reflecting the source's 1/16 in display precision; 0.1 mm for outside arc length at engine precision; exact kerf count.
scope: Validates quarter-circle spacing, outside arc length, and kerf count for the source's 3/4 in stock, 1/8 in kerf, 1/8 in uncut web, and 12 in inside radius. Material-specific default web recommendations and non-quarter-circle sweeps are excluded.
